item.title: Water purification
item.description: Water purification For the album, see Water purification (album). Infobox junk should not appear Water purification is the process of removing undesirable chemicals, biological contaminants, suspended solids, and gases from water.[1] The goal is to produce water fit for specific purposes. item.title: Emergency water treatment
item.description: Emergency water treatment If you have no other way to treat water, add 8 drops (1/8 teaspoon) of unscented household bleach per gallon of clear water. Stir and let it stand for 30 minutes. The water should have a slight chlorine odor. item.title: Water filter
item.description: Water filter A water filter removes impurities by lowering contamination of water using a fine physical barrier, a chemical process, or a biological process. Filters cleanse water to different extents, for purposes such as providing agricultural irrigation, accessible drinking water, public and private aquariums, and the safe use of ponds and swimming pools....
